Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model

Class ModelFacade

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.ModelFacade
public class ModelFacade extends Object
The ModelFacade class acts as a facade for accessing the model data. model. It provides methods for accessing and managing the main entities main entities of the system, such as equipment, units and line items, using the corresponding corresponding DAOs. This class implements the Singleton pattern to ensure that there is only one * instance of ModelFacade running. instance of ModelFacade running.
